Pick the latest tagged release of `github.com/tomasz-tomczyk/crit` at or
above 0.20.1 and record it in `internal/review/critjson/PIN` (one line: the
tag and commit sha). From that tag's source, write `types.go` mirroring
`Comment` (`internal/session/session.go`) and the finish payload
(`JSONPayload` in `internal/hooks/env.go`) exactly: field names, JSON tags,
optional fields, `comments_json` and `comments_unresolved_json` decoded as
`[]Comment`, `session_stats` as an optional struct. Copy the upstream files
those types were read from into `testdata/<tag>/upstream/`. Run crit at
that tag once against a scratch repo and once against a markdown file,
with a global hook that saves stdin; finish one unresolved and approve
one; save both payloads as `testdata/<tag>/finish_unresolved.json` and
`finish_approved.json` (scrub paths and the session key). Record in `PIN`
the hook keys and that project config is read from the cwd only, for
Task 4. `scripts/check-crit-contract.sh <tag>` re-fetches the upstream
files and diffs.

```go
func TestCritContract(t *testing.T) {
    for _, name := range []string{"finish_unresolved.json", "finish_approved.json"} {
        dec := json.NewDecoder(open(t, name))
        dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
        var got critjson.Finish
        if err := dec.Decode(&got); err != nil {
            t.Fatalf("%s no longer matches the pinned shape: %v", name, err)
        }
    }
    // and: finish_unresolved has Approved false and at least one comment in
    // CommentsJSON with StartLine > 0 and a non-empty Body; finish_approved
    // has Approved true and no unresolved comments.
}
```
